reading: Countries failed to secure a major new climate agreement at COP31 in Turkey after divisions over fossil fuels and finance emerged.
The protracted discussions continued from their scheduled Friday finish into Sunday, making this the longest UN climate conference in history.
Exhausted delegates received a fresh draft in the early hours of Sunday in an attempt to break the deadlock.
The proposed agreement was unacceptable to the EU, Pacific island nations and others because it omitted any direct mention of fossil fuels, the main cause of global warming.
Its only indirect reference to coal, oil and gas recalled the COP28 agreement to move away from fossil fuels in energy systems.
Saudi delegate Mohammad Ayoub said Arab countries had participated in good faith, while arguing that their share of historical greenhouse gas emissions was small.
Russia warned that moving away from fossil fuels too quickly would leave people unable to afford adequate energy.
Not only did this year's deal omit concrete figures, but it also failed to specify the baseline against which the pledge would be measured.
This lack of precision raised fears that richer nations would have excessive wriggle room in fulfilling the pledge.
Chris Bowen, the Australian minister serving as COP31 president of negotiations, described delegates' red lines as irreconcilable.
According to the UN, current government policies are likely to limit warming to about 2.8°C by 2100.
Long-term warming is nevertheless likely to overshoot the Paris agreement's 1.5°C goal within the next few years.

Many countries say they are committed to eventually bringing warming back down to 1.5°C, but this would require a major expansion of carbon dioxide removal technologies that do not yet operate at scale.
Although the main agreement fell through, delegates made progress on a framework to support workers and communities as economies shift towards clean energy.
The outcome prompted questions about whether a climate process that relies on consensus can succeed amid geopolitical divisions.
UN climate chief Simon Stiell said he would seek advice on procedural reform, with the next conference scheduled for November 2027 in Ethiopia.

vocabulary.definition: Continuing longer than expected or desired, often suggesting difficulty or frustration.
A situation in which opposing positions prevent an agreement or further progress.
With an honest intention to cooperate, rather than merely appearing to participate.
A reference value against which a result or the fulfilment of a pledge can be measured.
An informal, often critical expression for freedom to avoid a firm commitment or interpret it advantageously.
So opposed that the positions cannot be brought into agreement.
To exceed a target or limit, without necessarily remaining above it permanently.
At a level of deployment large enough to address the wider problem, rather than through limited applications.
Failed to be completed or secured after being planned or pursued.
Changes to the rules or methods through which a process operates and reaches decisions.

entries.ja: 予想や希望よりも長く続くこと。多くの場合、困難やいら立ちを伴うことを示唆する。
entries.ko: 예상하거나 바라던 것보다 더 오래 계속되는 것으로, 흔히 어려움이나 답답함이 따름을 암시한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 持续时间比预期或期望的更长，往往暗示过程艰难或令人沮丧。
entries.es: Que se prolonga más de lo esperado o deseado, a menudo sugiriendo dificultad o frustración.
entries.pt-BR: Que continua por mais tempo do que o esperado ou desejado, muitas vezes sugerindo dificuldade ou frustração.
entries.fr: Qui dure plus longtemps que prévu ou souhaité, ce qui suggère souvent des difficultés ou de la frustration.
entries.de: Länger andauernd als erwartet oder gewünscht, wobei häufig Schwierigkeiten oder Frustration mitschwingen.

entries.ja: 立場の対立によって、合意やそれ以上の進展が妨げられている状況。
entries.ko: 서로 대립하는 입장 때문에 합의하거나 더 나아갈 수 없는 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 因各方立场对立而无法达成协议或取得进一步进展的局面。
entries.es: Situación en la que las posturas enfrentadas impiden llegar a un acuerdo o seguir avanzando.
entries.pt-BR: Situação em que posições opostas impedem um acordo ou novos avanços.
entries.fr: Situation dans laquelle des positions opposées empêchent de parvenir à un accord ou de progresser davantage.
entries.de: Eine Situation, in der gegensätzliche Positionen eine Einigung oder weitere Fortschritte verhindern.

entries.ja: 参加しているように見せかけるだけではなく、誠実に協力しようとする意思を持って。
entries.ko: 단지 참여하는 척하는 것이 아니라, 협력하려는 진실한 의도를 가지고.
entries.zh-Hans: 怀着真诚合作的意愿，而不是仅仅做出参与的样子。
entries.es: Con una intención sincera de cooperar, en lugar de limitarse a aparentar que se participa.
entries.pt-BR: Com a intenção sincera de cooperar, em vez de apenas aparentar participação.
entries.fr: Avec une intention sincère de coopérer, plutôt que de simplement faire semblant de participer.
entries.de: Mit der aufrichtigen Absicht, zusammenzuarbeiten, statt eine Beteiligung nur vorzutäuschen.

entries.ja: 結果や約束の達成度を測る際に、比較の基準となる値。
entries.ko: 결과나 약속의 이행 정도를 측정할 때 비교 기준으로 삼는 값.
entries.zh-Hans: 用于衡量结果或承诺履行情况的参照数值。
entries.es: Valor de referencia con el que se puede comparar un resultado o medir el cumplimiento de una promesa.
entries.pt-BR: Valor de referência usado para medir um resultado ou o cumprimento de uma promessa.
entries.fr: Valeur de référence permettant de mesurer un résultat ou le respect d’un engagement.
entries.de: Ein Referenzwert, an dem sich ein Ergebnis oder die Erfüllung einer Zusage messen lässt.

entries.ja: 明確な約束を回避したり、その約束を自分に都合よく解釈したりできる余地を指す、くだけた表現。批判的な意味で使われることが多い。
entries.ko: 확고한 약속을 피하거나 그 약속을 자신에게 유리하게 해석할 수 있는 여지를 뜻하는 비격식 표현으로, 흔히 비판적인 의미로 쓰인다.
entries.zh-Hans: 一种非正式且常带批评意味的说法，指可以回避明确承诺或对该承诺作出有利于自己的解释的余地。
entries.es: Expresión informal, a menudo crítica, que se refiere al margen para eludir un compromiso firme o interpretarlo de forma ventajosa para uno mismo.
entries.pt-BR: Expressão informal, muitas vezes crítica, que se refere à margem para escapar de um compromisso firme ou interpretá-lo em benefício próprio.
entries.fr: Expression familière, souvent critique, désignant la marge de liberté permettant de se soustraire à un engagement ferme ou de l’interpréter à son avantage.
entries.de: Ein umgangssprachlicher, oft kritischer Ausdruck für den Spielraum, sich einer festen Zusage zu entziehen oder sie zum eigenen Vorteil auszulegen.

entries.ja: 立場があまりに対立していて、合意に至るよう調整することができないこと。
entries.ko: 입장들이 너무나 대립하여 합의에 이르도록 조정할 수 없는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 各方立场对立到无法协调一致的程度。
entries.es: Se dice de posturas tan opuestas que no es posible conciliarlas.
entries.pt-BR: Diz-se de posições tão opostas que não é possível conciliá-las.
entries.fr: Se dit de positions si opposées qu’il est impossible de les concilier.
entries.de: So gegensätzlich, dass sich die Positionen nicht miteinander in Einklang bringen lassen.

entries.ja: 目標値や限度を超えること。ただし、その後も永久にそれを上回り続けるとは限らない。
entries.ko: 목표치나 한도를 넘는 것으로, 반드시 그보다 높은 상태가 영구히 지속된다는 뜻은 아니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 超过目标值或限度，但不一定会永久保持在其上方。
entries.es: Superar un objetivo o un límite, sin que eso implique necesariamente mantenerse por encima de él de forma permanente.
entries.pt-BR: Ultrapassar uma meta ou um limite, sem necessariamente permanecer acima desse nível para sempre.
entries.fr: Dépasser un objectif ou une limite, sans nécessairement rester au-dessus de façon permanente.
entries.de: Einen Zielwert oder eine Grenze überschreiten, ohne zwangsläufig dauerhaft darüber zu bleiben.

entries.ja: 限られた用途で使うだけではなく、より広い範囲の問題に対処できるほど十分な規模で導入・活用されている状態で。
entries.ko: 제한적인 용도로만 사용하는 수준을 넘어, 더 광범위한 문제에 대응할 수 있을 만큼 충분히 큰 규모로 도입되어 활용되는 상태로.
entries.zh-Hans: 以足以应对更广泛问题的规模部署和应用，而不是仅用于有限的用途。
entries.es: Con un nivel de implementación lo bastante amplio como para abordar el problema a mayor escala, en lugar de limitarse a aplicaciones reducidas.
entries.pt-BR: Com um nível de implementação grande o suficiente para enfrentar o problema de forma mais ampla, em vez de se restringir a aplicações limitadas.
entries.fr: À un niveau de déploiement suffisamment important pour traiter le problème plus largement, plutôt que dans le cadre d’applications limitées.
entries.de: In einem ausreichend großen Umfang eingesetzt, um das umfassendere Problem anzugehen, statt nur in begrenzten Anwendungen.

entries.ja: 計画されたり実現に向けて取り組まれたりしたものの、完成や成立に至らなかったこと。
entries.ko: 계획되거나 성사시키기 위한 노력이 있었지만, 결국 완료되거나 성사되지 못했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 虽已进行计划或努力争取，但最终未能完成或达成。
entries.es: No llegó a completarse o concretarse después de haberse planificado o intentado conseguir.
entries.pt-BR: Não foi concluído ou concretizado, apesar de ter sido planejado ou de terem sido feitos esforços para realizá-lo.
entries.fr: N’a pas pu être achevé ou concrétisé après avoir été prévu ou avoir fait l’objet d’efforts pour y parvenir.
entries.de: Kam nicht zum Abschluss oder zustande, nachdem es geplant oder angestrebt worden war.

entries.ja: ある手続きの進め方や意思決定の仕方を定める規則や方法を変更すること。
entries.ko: 어떤 절차가 진행되고 결정에 이르는 데 적용되는 규칙이나 방법을 바꾸는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 对一项程序如何运作以及如何作出决定所依据的规则或方法进行的修改。
entries.es: Cambios en las reglas o los métodos mediante los cuales se desarrolla un proceso y se toman decisiones.
entries.pt-BR: Mudanças nas regras ou nos métodos pelos quais um processo funciona e chega a decisões.
entries.fr: Modifications des règles ou des méthodes qui régissent le déroulement d’un processus et la prise de décisions.
entries.de: Änderungen an den Regeln oder Methoden, nach denen ein Verfahren abläuft und Entscheidungen getroffen werden.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
